key_highlights: ASX registers third consecutive week of gains driven by rallies in materials and technology sectors.
Surprise jump in unemployment dampens RBA rate hike expectations and exerts downward pressure on the AUD.
Gold sector heats up with a $38bn corporate battle for Australia's top producer alongside junior exploration hits.
Sydney auction clearance rates drop sharply into crash territory amid rising labor market softening.

sectors.trend: Strong upward momentum led by a $38bn M&A battle for top gold assets and accelerated exploration across gold and rare earths.
sectors.implications: Elevated gold and critical minerals valuations provide ASX buffer despite persistent China manufacturing dumping ('China Shock 2.0') concerns.

sectors.trend: Weakening employment data quashes RBA rate hike risks, but rising joblessness clouds bank credit quality and loan growth.
sectors.implications: NIM expansion cycle concluded; bank valuations face pressure from emerging asset quality risks and declining property clearance.

sectors.trend: East coast domestic gas deficit risks escalate while Timor-Leste agreements advance and offshore protest actions persist.
sectors.implications: Contracted domestic gas prices remain supported; regulatory net-zero litigation and offshore operational risks stay elevated.

sectors.trend: Sector rally extends alongside mining, driving index outperformance despite venture and consumer-app valuation compression.
sectors.implications: Institutional flows favor profitable, enterprise ASX tech leaders over early-stage discretionary plays.

sectors.trend: Sydney residential auction market experiences severe contraction; secondary housing distress emerges.
sectors.implications: Residential developers and housing-exposed REITs face downward valuation revisions; commercial retail prime assets hold selective demand.

key_themes: Labor market deterioration recalibrates RBA rate trajectory toward future easing
Resource sector consolidation centered on gold M&A and critical minerals output
Residential property market liquidity contraction in key metropolitan markets
AUD depreciation prompted by shifting macroeconomic fundamentals

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-beta domestic discretionary consumer and retail banking equities in favor of defensive quality.
Hedge exposure to residential development and domestic mortgage credit providers.
Focus on low-cost bulk commodity producers and gold equities with unhedged upside.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Gas Supply Shortages and Policy Intervention
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritize diversified energy producers with substantial offshore LNG revenue streams.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Top-Tier ASX Gold Producers Amid Consolidation
opportunities.rationale: Corporate takeover activity and strong gold prices support premium multiples and operational cash flows.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to Core Mining and Tech Leaders
opportunities.rationale: Index momentum remains underpinned by large-cap resource cash generation and software resilience.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Domestic Bank Exposure on Rising Loan Book Risks
defensive_moves.rationale: Surging unemployment and housing auction declines point to peaking net interest margins and elevated bad debt provisioning.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD Currency Exposure via USD-Earner Holdings
defensive_moves.rationale: Softening domestic employment and tempered RBA hike expectations heighten AUD/USD downside volatility.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX expected to trade in a consolidative range; strength in materials and tech offsets domestic banking and consumer weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: Mid-term prospects hinge on RBA easing cycle commencement to stabilize housing and consumption, alongside external demand resilience.
key_catalysts: Next RBA monetary policy meeting and cash rate decision
Upcoming Australian ABS Consumer Price Index (CPI) print
East Coast domestic gas market policy declarations
M&A developments in the $38bn gold sector takeover contest
watch_list: Sydney and Melbourne weekend auction clearance rates
Spot gold and iron ore export benchmark prices
